title: ui reads and tutorial hints (schema 1)
description: ui/data/reads.json: what the HUD says about reads (which stance answers each finisher kind) and about the guided first match (docs/ui/hud-spec.md sections 18 and 19; Narrative's lines in docs/narrative/tutorial-hints.md). Version field: schema. Policy: closed. Hints are keyed beat.variant (for example b3.hint). Cross-references (the counter stances exist in terms.json, every hint belongs to a listed beat, every beat has a main hint, a hint stays short) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js.
